$comment: The Dockerfile's own build stage, standalone (not `extends`) because the docker build context for this plugin is scoped to this directory alone (both ci.yml's `docker build` and publish.yml's build-push-action pass `plugins/research-feed-store` as the context, never the repo root), so `tsconfig.build.json`'s `extends: "../../tsconfig.base.json"` can't reach outside it -- COPYing a path above the build context isn't possible at all. This file's compilerOptions must be kept in sync with tsconfig.base.json + tsconfig.build.json's own overrides; `src/tsconfig-docker-drift.test.ts` fails if they diverge.
